claims.quote: Leptobotia guilinensis is a botiid loach from southern China, described from Guangxi Province and also recorded from neighbouring Hunan.

Described from a tributary of the Yangtze River (aka Chiang Jiang), Guangxi Province, southern China and also recorded from neighbouring Hunan Province including the Wulin mountain range to the northwest.
